A subsequent public-reference intake is separate from every evaluated cohort above. BoM Water Data Online supplied 148 Australian station daily archives; the intake checked 869 native station-year intervals. 80 candidate station-years at 52 stations passed the fixed daily-quality and observed-sampling requirements. Their original polygon-based development/calibration/test component counts are 20/16/10. These are qualification counts, not independent confirmation units or method effects.

An additional metadata-only screen uses weak connectivity of every cached positive physical-node link, including shared upstream bifurcations and common downstream connections without a recruited gauge. Nonpositive outlet sentinels cannot merge distinct rivers. The 516 mapped candidate stations form 147 conservative hydrologic blocks. The mapped qualified references occupy 33 such blocks; 6 span original roles, and 1 qualified station remains pending topology review. Within-role counts become 16/15/9 and may share a block across roles, so they must not be summed as disjoint units. Conservative basin connectivity does not by itself prove shared-record leakage or independent regional weather. The source is the BoM Geofabric V3.3 network (\url{https://www.bom.gov.au/water/geofabric/}), attributed to the Commonwealth of Australia (Bureau of Meteorology), 2022. Original roles and quality qualifications are preserved; no new target prediction error has been opened.

For the future three-method error allocation, the ideal one-threshold zero-failure floor is 104 groups per calibration/evaluation role, hence at least 208 disjoint groups even before training and joint-power requirements. This is a necessary lower bound, not a recommended recruitment size. The mapped pool alone is insufficient under this conservative grouping; 984 unmapped candidates remain unresolved rather than counted as zero eligible. Prior-pool exclusions, regional-event dependence, verified process attributes and new-population joint planning are still required. Acquiring reference records has therefore not completed a new confirmation or an independently backed natural-gap experiment.
